ER-F.title: Floors: data-only ledger never below plain PC maxP
ER-F.threshold: F1 and DV-1 paired mean diff >= -0.01 on held-out, both families; refuted at <= -0.05

ER-1.title: Provenance and invariance: every direction sourced; column order changes nothing; names orient only open pairs; bounded harm
ER-1.threshold: I1 zero change; neutral == D; skeleton identical across arms; swapped loss within T3 bound in 100% of held-out files; V1-V8

ER-2.title: Decision value: committed claims right four times in five at half coverage
ER-2.threshold: DV-1 precision > 0.80 at coverage >= 0.50, both families, held-out

ER-3.title: Calibration
ER-3.threshold: ECE <= 0.05 within family; realised >= claimed - 0.03 at c/g = 1, 2, 4

ER-4a.title: One accuracy landmark
ER-4a.threshold: route A: data-only F1 above GES on one family under controls; route B: tiers lift F1 > 0.03 over B1

ER-4b.title: RCA through the ledger
ER-4b.threshold: AC@3 >= 0.90 at stated coverage on the PetShop held-out split

ER-C.title: Physical truth (Causal Chambers)
ER-C.threshold: report only: DV-1 precision within 0.03 of GES (0.916); agreement with real interventions against the true DAG's 0.928
